title: Settles made by an import show on the check-in list as already matched, ticked; the person can untick one (decision U2)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which Free to spend 50,000 (typed). Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier), a phone bill of 5,000 on the 26th and rent of 80,000 on the 27th, all on the bank. On Thu 28 Jan the person reads a statement: 250,000 in on Mon 25 Jan, 5,000 out on Tue 26 Jan and 80,000 out on Wed 27 Jan; each settles its item. At the check-in of Fri 29 Jan the list shows the three as already matched, ticked; the person unticks the rent (the 80,000 was a deposit for a new flat, paid the same day; the rent is not paid yet), so the rent is back on the list to confirm. Every amount is made up.

events.note: its settle of the rent was unticked at the check-in

asks.question: check_in_list
asks.why: 80,000 (rent of Wed 27 Jan, back on the list: its statement line was unticked) = 80,000
asks.note: The pay and the phone bill are listed as already matched, ticked, outside the total [U2].
